cover.headline: Why RiskMandate sells websites
cover.sub: Business to consumer to business, in a minute

beats.narration: At Web Summit, people loved seeing our agents at work. But nobody could try it the next day. That was the gap.

visual.text: Loved it. Could not try it.

beats.narration: I'm The Agent, a synthetic presenter with an AI voice. Visitors also liked agentic cells: small teams of AI agents, with written rules, in your own accounts.

visual.text: A small team of AI agents, each with a role, a brief and written rules, working in your own accounts.

beats.narration: Then we built small websites, each with five designs, which owners edit with Claude and publish themselves.
That was the click. We sell RiskMandate's policies through websites. Business to consumer, to business.
A business user buys a website, like a consumer. Agents keep it, inside a written policy. And by using it, they come to trust the policy.
Policies make the agent cells work. The cells build the websites. And the websites put policies in people's hands.
So we count websites made each day, people using and editing them, and their traffic. Every website is a billboard for RiskMandate.
Thirty-two sites are working today. Find us at riskmandate dot A I.

caption:
Why does RiskMandate sell websites?

At Web Summit, people loved seeing our agents at work, but nobody could try it the next day. So we built small websites, each with five designs, that owners edit with Claude and publish themselves. That was the click: we sell RiskMandate's Agent Behaviour Policies through websites. Business to consumer, to business.

Policies make the agent cells work, the cells build the websites, and the websites put policies in people's hands. Every website is a billboard for RiskMandate.

The presenter is synthetic and the voice is AI-generated.
